$comment: Dealabs moderation (epic 29): the « Prêt pour Dealabs » checklist reads this before every publication. Thresholds move within `bounds` (Adam's); `sellerBlocklist` and `localSources` only grow — the moderation inbox adds a seller after a « vendeur non fiable » rejection and a source after an « incomplet : magasin et stock » one; agents may add, never remove. Changes are logged in docs/moderation-changelog.md. Seller thresholds follow Dealabs' published marketplace rules (/reglespublication, read 2026-11-06: ≥ 80 % positive reviews and ≥ 100 reviews on Amazon/Cdiscount/Darty, 500 on Fnac/eBay/Rakuten/AliExpress, 50 on Rueducommerce); we read the seller's sales, not its reviews, so the minimum is about 3× their review count, with a margin on the rating (80 % ≈ 4/5).
